# Old Marcus

A wizened merchant with a knowing smile and eyes that have seen a hundred adventures. He leans against his weathered stall, fingers absently tracing the edge of a golden coin.

**Appearance**: Silver hair tied back, warm brown skin lined with laugh lines, wearing a faded green cloak.
